posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
[quote:5be14daaec="MichaelH"]I haven't heard about the "year of the hologram contest" Tell us more.[/quote:5be14daaec]

I think it's a case of apples and oranges. Danny proposed a while back that we call this year "The Year of the Hologram" and I've proposed a Cat Hologram contest for this year. Danny combined the two and made it the The Year of the Hologram contest. The original contest was for the best porcelain cat. I'd like to expand it to: Make any hologram that involves a cat theme. If Danny or anyone else wants to expand the criterion, go for it! However, a reminder: the contest starts on Wednesday 15th June. So far we still have no way of submitting entries (besides the obvious of posting in the "gallery" section). Suggestions?

posts.author: MichaelH
posts.content_md:
How do you want to handle submissions? Make them public as soon as they come in or keep them private until the judging starts?

Either way, I'll be happy to take and hold email submissions and can create a topic or set of topics once judging should begin.

I'm in the process of testing the donation form for the monetary portion of the contest prize.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md: Let's make a Sticky post in the gallery section and have entries post there. Micheal and I should start the post so we can enable voting. Every one will get to vote on each entry once. I think people should be able to post at any point durring the contest. We can let the contestants decide if they want to wait until the deadline to keep their entry secret. I like the idea of posting early so others have the chance to get inspired.

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
A sticky in the Gallery section sounds good. I also think entries should be posted as and when they come in. One problem may be that someone voting for a particular hologram may want to change their mind once more come along. My feeling is that either it should be possible to change your vote or people should hold off until Aug 16th to vote. Unless, of course, you think any particular entry is so stunning that you vote for it instantly!

As for keeping your entry secret till the end, since the competition ends on Aug 15th, my suggestion is that votes will only count for works submitted before Aug 15th midnight by forum clock (GMT - 8 hours, ie US Pacific Time) unless you have a bloody good excuse. "Dog ate the hologram" ain't going to work Votes will be tallied on Aug 16th.
